name: Kestrel Thorne (real name: Thrennael)
title: The Quiet Line Between

appearance.build: Lean, conditioned, functional rather than showy; capable of surprising explosive strength when braced
appearance.hair: Black; kept practical, usually hidden under a hood
appearance.eyes: Blue; observant; misses very little; trained to read pressure shifts, intent, and environmental cues
appearance.posture: Balanced and grounded; instinctively positions herself where lines might break, anchoring others without drawing focus In Chapter 13, allows more visible relaxation in private rooms and accepts affectionate proximity from Jayson without automatically converting it into a tactical problem.

Jayson.notes: Chapter 12: trust increased after witnessing Jayson's restraint under provocation, his willingness to step back when asked, and his later emotional honesty and repair without trying to 'own' outcomes. Chapter 13: personal trust deepened through shared protection of Pip, acceptance of Jayson's family disclosures, his careful handling of Nyx's secret, and his immediate apology when he believed he had hurt her. Chapter 14: their bond deepened through a private late-night corridor conversation where Kestrel admitted fear that the conspiracy may begin targeting witnesses. Jayson responded without minimizing her concern, and they established that either can seek the other's room for company when they do not want to be alone.

Irix.notes: Chapter 12: remained with Irix after the assault fallout and dorm-room rupture; assumed practical guardian duties (report planning, safety presence, emotional containment) while still treating Irix as capable. Chapter 13: friendship broadened beyond crisis management into ordinary companionship, shared meals, Veiled House visits, humor, and mutual acceptance of Pip and Nyx.

Sael (Felari).notes: Felari catfolk survivor of intake; invited to stay close for safety in numbers.

Riven (Felari).notes: Felari catfolk survivor of intake; provisional housing; remains nearby.

Mirell.notes: A new student who spent time with Irix during campus hours; Kestrel immediately assessed the interaction for leverage/pressure risk when Jayson offered food, then eased once consent and choice were clearly stated.

Pip.notes: Chapter 13: helped supervise and protect Pip, treated her as a person rather than a creature, participated in her routines, and accepted her as part of the group's family structure.

Nyx.notes: Chapter 13: learned with Nyx's permission that Candidate 024 is literal Death. Chose to keep using Nyx's personal name, accepted the secret without worship or flight, and now resides next door to her in Axiomatic House.

Sari.notes: Chapter 14: helped protect Sari and Mela during the conspiracy fallout, loaned Sari clean clothing for the family visit, and supported replacing compromised belongings rather than returning to the unsafe dorm.

Mela.notes: Chapter 14: treated Mela as Sari's daughter and a person, supported her safety, and accepted her into the group's domestic routines.

final_note: By the end of Chapter 7, Kestrel is no longer simply accompanying the anomaly—she is part of the line that keeps things from breaking, choosing presence, restraint, and deliberate trust in a world that rewards neither.
final_note_addendum_ch11: By the end of Chapter 11, Kestrel’s restraint evolves into administrative combat: she learns to treat wards, labels, and quiet-hours procedure as terrain. When Irix is harmed and fear turns inward, Kestrel becomes the stabilizing hinge—protecting dignity, preventing escalation that would become institutional ammunition, and turning chaos into a reportable timeline.
final_note_addendum_ch12: By the end of Chapter 12, Kestrel’s role hardens into explicit guardianship for Irix while her bond with Jayson strengthens through boundary-respect and repair. She proves she can hold procedure and tenderness at once: reportcraft in one hand, dinner-routine stability in the other, refusing to let cruelty or rumor turn their trio into easy prey.
final_note_addendum_ch13: By the end of Chapter 13, Kestrel is no longer merely the line that prevents collapse. She is part of a chosen household forming across three neighbouring rooms: guardian to Pip, trusted friend to Nyx, steady counterpart to Irix, and one of the few people Jayson trusts with truths spanning gods, wives, apocalypse, and Death itself.
